name: the-pair
description: Open-source AI pair programming desktop app: a read-only Mentor and an Executor agent cross-check each other's code to catch AI mistakes before they land. Bring any model — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Qwen or local Ollama. No agent CLI needed. macOS / Windows / Linux.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: or sign in with a ChatGPT, Command Code, OpenCode Go or Muse Code subscription
capability_evidence.worktree-isolation: ention across all pairs, and which model combinations have worked
capability_evidence.model-routing: y read, edit and command the Executor makes, live, with a stop button.
capability_evidence.usage-analytics: — task, plans, results, reviews and live turns in a single scrollable feed, with search and role filters
capability_evidence.self-hosted: Dedicated review role ✅ Mentor (read-only) ❌ Self-review only ❌ Self-review only
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: stays in the app's data directory, never inside your repository.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Aider, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot

friction.note_en: Easy. install via global npm install, download a release binary; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure environment variables, API key configuration; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 global npm install、download a release binary 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 environment variables、API key configuration；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: Two AI agents on one task.
highlights: Stall detection — a warning after 120 s without output, stalled after 600 s
Worktrees — run each task in its own git worktree on a the-pair/… branch, then commit and push from the inspector
Four languages — English, 简体中文, 日本語 and 한국어
Usage tracking — tokens per turn and per run, estimated cost, request count and last output
analysis.summary_zh_native: 两个 AI Agent 做同一个任务：一个写代码，另一个审查。
highlights_zh: 自带端点 — 导入其他 Agent 的配置（opencode、codex、claude、kimi、pi、omp、gemini、killi）、手动添加密钥，或用 ChatGPT、Command Code、OpenCode Go、Muse Code 订阅登录
卡顿检测 — 120 秒无输出时警告，600 秒后标记为卡住
Worktree — 每个任务可以在独立的 git worktree 和 the-pair/… 分支上运行，然后直接在检查器里提交和推送
统一的会话控制台 — 任务、计划、结果、审查和实时轮次都在同一条可滚动的信息流里，支持搜索和按角色筛选
